title: Trie: Word Search
statement:
Build a Trie from a set of words, then answer Q search queries.

For each query word, print "Yes" if the word exists exactly in the Trie (full match), otherwise print "No".
constraints:
1 <= W <= 1000 (number of words to insert)
1 <= Q <= 1000 (queries)
1 <= |word| <= 20
All words are lowercase English letters.
inputFormat:
The first line contains W.
The next W lines each contain a word to insert.
The next line contains Q.
The next Q lines each contain a query word.
outputFormat: Q lines: "Yes" or "No" for each query.

examples.explanation: 'apple' and 'bat' are in the trie; 'ap' is only a prefix.
'hell' is a prefix only; 'hello' is a full match.
